evidence.summary: README: 'Book a slot, cancel up to 24 hours before, and pay by card (Stripe).'
book() loads the slot, raises ValueError('slot taken') if slot.taken, charges the slot price, then inserts a Booking with user_id, slot_id, created_at.
cancel() raises PermissionError('too late to cancel') when slot.starts_at minus now is under 24 hours, otherwise hard-deletes the booking.
Imports charge from a payments module; the file's own comment says the module is not included in this source.
charge(user_id, slot['price']) is called before the booking row is written; no refund call exists in cancel().
Storage goes through an injected db object (get/insert/delete); the database engine and schema are not in the folder.

architecture.backend: Python functions over an injected db object; payments delegated to a missing payments module

features.name: Book a slot
features.description: A user books one open slot; the booking is paid at the moment it is made.
features.observed_behaviour: Load slot; if slot.taken raise 'slot taken'; charge the user the slot price; insert a Booking (user_id, slot_id, created_at=utcnow).
features.business_logic: A taken slot cannot be booked. Payment happens before the booking is written. The code never sets slot.taken, so how a slot becomes taken is not visible here.
features.integration: needs users, slots and payments in the unified app

features.name: Cancel a booking up to 24 hours before
features.description: A user cancels a booking if the slot starts 24 hours or more from now.
features.observed_behaviour: Load booking and slot; if starts_at - now < 24h raise 'too late to cancel'; else delete the booking row.
features.business_logic: Cancellation window: at least 24 hours before slot start. Cancel is a hard delete. No refund is issued in this code.
features.integration: refund behaviour must be decided with payments

features.name: Pay by card (Stripe)
features.description: The slot price is charged to the user by card through Stripe when booking.
features.observed_behaviour: bookings.py calls charge(user_id, price) before writing the booking. The charge implementation (payments.py) is not in the folder.
features.business_logic: Amount is slot.price. Currency, failure handling, idempotency and refunds are unknown.
features.integration: Stripe (README); keys would be configuration, never copied

unknowns: payments.py (the charge implementation) is not in the folder: Stripe usage, currency, failure handling, idempotency and refunds are unknown. Providing payments.py would settle it.
The db layer and schema are not in the folder: database engine, id types and constraints are unknown.
Nothing marks a slot as taken after booking (bookings.py never updates slot.taken); double-booking protection may live elsewhere or be missing.
No auth, users, slot creation, API routes or UI are in the folder.
Charge happens before insert with no rollback: what happens if the insert fails after a successful charge is unknown.
